scene: The crawler rattles across suspension cables as passengers share warm cider.
beats: You dial past squealing static until a jaunty pirate accordion jig fills the car. The crawler thumps against the Gear Bridge bumper, and the pneumatic doors hiss wide open.
Sweet clove cider warms you down to your toes while the cabin rattles over the final cable. The crawler glides to a halt, doors parting onto Gear Bridge.
A pleasant chime rings out and a heavy brass token drops into your hand. Outside, giant cogs mesh into place as the crawler docks and the doors slide back.
picture: Inside a wood-panelled crawler car side view. On the far left sits a humming brass radio. To the left, a passenger offers cider. Centre, the player stands holding a hand strap. Beside him, large windows show Midnight Radio Repair shrinking. On the far right is a brass pneumatic tube receptacle beside exit doors.
shown: a humming brass radio on a shelf on the far left
a passenger extending a steaming paper cup on the left
a brass pneumatic tube receptacle on the far right wall

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put, rolling past Gear Bridge as suspension grease gently mists the windows. At the depot, you transfer onto a creaking window-cleaner gondola that floats you straight up to Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Dim yellow lights sway overhead as the cable car glides through purple dusk.
beats: Static clears into a lively accordion tune that gets feet tapping. The car bumps into the Gear Bridge station bumper, and pneumatic doors hiss open.
The sweet, spiced cider warms your hands through the paper cup. Cable wheels hum to a stop against the dock, and sliding doors rattle wide.
A chime rings as a shiny metal token plinks into your palm. Giant gears lock outside, and the exit doors slide open with a gentle whoosh.
variants.ride_on: You keep your seat, coasting past Gear Bridge through the mist. At the end depot, you board a creaky window-cleaner gondola that floats all the way to Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Luggage rests in overhead racks while evening colors streak past the window glass.
beats: You twist the dial until accordion music bounces happily through the compartment. The vehicle thuds against the Gear Bridge buffer, and the pneumatic doors open.
A sip of clove cider takes the chill away. Outside, the cables slow as the car settles into Gear Bridge and the doors pull apart smoothly.
A satisfying ping sounds and a thick brass token clatters down. The car docks against massive gears, and the exit doors slide open to the platform.
variants.ride_on: Passing Gear Bridge, you ride all the way to the depot. There, you switch into a swaying window-cleaner gondola that hoists you up toward Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: A mechanical parrot perches behind you while you ponder your hunt for {quest}.
beats: Fiddling with the dial brings in a jolly accordion jig. With a sudden jolt, the car docks at Gear Bridge and the heavy doors hiss open.
You take the hot cup, enjoying the cinnamon scent. The rattling cables ease to a halt at Gear Bridge, and the sliding doors part before you.
You pull the flap and catch a smooth brass token as bells ring. The car brakes at Gear Bridge, and the doors glide open right on time.
variants.ride_on: You stay aboard as the car rolls on, gliding beyond Gear Bridge. At the terminal depot, you catch an old window-cleaner gondola rising right to Rainmaker Rooftops.
